content.text: TURN ASSEMBLY OVER, REMOVE SET BOLTS AND REMOVE TWO VALVE BODY COVERS AND GASKETS

items: (b) Remove the spring and steel ball.

content.text: CAUTION: Cover the spring with your hand. Slowly remove the bolt, being careful not to pop out the spring.

items: (b) Remove the solenoid from the bore.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of No. 1 and No. 2 solenoids with three bolts from top of valve body

items: (a) Remove the three bolts, the solenoid and gasket.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of two springs from valve body bore

items: (b) Remove the two springs from the bore.
